datasets.name: da9a8ff7
queryLines:
WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        CASE
            WHEN room_type IN (
                'Entire home/apt', 'Private room'
            ) THEN room_type
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS room_type_group,
        SUM(total_listings) AS total_listings
    FROM workspace.gold.room_type_metrics
    GROUP BY
        city,
        CASE
            WHEN room_type IN (
                'Entire home/apt', 'Private room'
            ) THEN room_type
            ELSE 'Other'
        END
)
SELECT
    city,
    room_type_group,
    total_listings,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * total_listings
        / SUM(total_listings) OVER (PARTITION BY city),
        2
    ) AS share_pct
FROM grouped;

datasets.name: 4e704967
queryLines:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        neighbourhood,
        total_listings,
        median_price_eur,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY city
            ORDER BY median_price_eur DESC
        ) AS rank_in_city
    FROM workspace.gold.neighbourhood_metrics
    WHERE total_listings >= 30
)
SELECT
    city,
    neighbourhood,
    total_listings,
    median_price_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_city <= 5
ORDER BY city, median_price_eur DESC;

datasets.name: 41c49ef1
queryLines:
SELECT
    city,
    room_type,
    total_listings,
    median_price_eur
FROM workspace.gold.room_type_metrics
WHERE city IN ('rome', 'sicily')
  AND room_type IN (
      'Entire home/apt',
      'Private room'
  )
ORDER BY room_type, city;

datasets.name: e20c65d3
queryLines:
WITH prices AS (
    SELECT
        room_type,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN city = 'rome'
            THEN median_price_eur
        END) AS rome_price,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN city = 'sicily'
            THEN median_price_eur
        END) AS sicily_price
    FROM workspace.gold.room_type_metrics
    WHERE city IN ('rome', 'sicily')
      AND room_type IN (
          'Entire home/apt',
          'Private room'
      )
    GROUP BY room_type
)

SELECT
    room_type,
    rome_price,
    sicily_price,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (rome_price / NULLIF(sicily_price, 0) - 1),
        2
    ) AS price_premium_pct
FROM prices
ORDER BY price_premium_pct DESC;

datasets.name: adfda582
queryLines:
WITH test_predictions AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        id AS listing_id,
        room_type,
        price AS actual_price_eur,
        model_pred AS predicted_price_eur,
        ROUND(model_pred - price, 2) AS error_eur,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY city
            ORDER BY xxhash64(id, city)
        ) AS row_num
    FROM workspace.gold.price_predictions
    WHERE model_version = 'v1'
      AND run_label = 'train_test'
      AND split = 'test'
      AND city IN ('rome', 'sicily')
      AND price IS NOT NULL
      AND model_pred IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    city,
    listing_id,
    room_type,
    ROUND(actual_price_eur, 2) AS actual_price_eur,
    ROUND(predicted_price_eur, 2) AS predicted_price_eur,
    error_eur
FROM test_predictions
WHERE row_num <= 1000;

datasets.name: 32cc4b40
queryLines:
WITH test_predictions AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        COALESCE(room_type, 'Unknown') AS room_type,
        ABS(model_pred - price) AS abs_error_eur
    FROM workspace.gold.price_predictions
    WHERE model_version = 'v1'
      AND run_label = 'train_test'
      AND split = 'test'
      AND city IN ('rome', 'sicily')
      AND price IS NOT NULL
      AND model_pred IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    city,
    room_type,
    COUNT(*) AS n_test,
    ROUND(AVG(abs_error_eur), 2) AS mae_eur
FROM test_predictions
GROUP BY city, room_type
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY room_type, city;

datasets.name: ae96c065
queryLines:
WITH predictions AS (
    SELECT
        city,
        id AS listing_id,
        room_type,
        price AS actual_price_eur,
        model_pred AS predicted_price_eur,
        model_pred - price AS error_eur,

        CASE
            WHEN model_pred < price
                THEN 'Underpredicted'
            WHEN model_pred > price
                THEN 'Overpredicted'
        END AS error_type

    FROM workspace.gold.price_predictions
    WHERE model_version = 'v1'
      AND run_label = 'train_test'
      AND split = 'test'
      AND city IN ('rome', 'sicily')
      AND price IS NOT NULL
      AND model_pred IS NOT NULL
      AND model_pred <> price
),

ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY city, error_type
            ORDER BY ABS(error_eur) DESC, listing_id
        ) AS error_rank
    FROM predictions
)

SELECT
    city,
    error_type,
    error_rank,
    listing_id,
    room_type,
    ROUND(actual_price_eur, 2) AS actual_price_eur,
    ROUND(predicted_price_eur, 2) AS predicted_price_eur,
    ROUND(error_eur, 2) AS error_eur,
    ROUND(ABS(error_eur), 2) AS absolute_error_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE error_rank <= 5
ORDER BY
    city,
    error_type,
    error_rank;

datasets.name: 859d860d
queryLines:
WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        model_version,
        run_label,
        mae_baseline,
        mae_model
    FROM workspace.gold.model_metrics_all
    WHERE city = 'naples'
)

SELECT
    'Baseline' AS model,
    mae_baseline AS mae_eur,
    1 AS sort_order
FROM metrics
WHERE model_version = 'v1'
  AND run_label = 'first_run'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'v1 - First Run' AS model,
    mae_model AS mae_eur,
    2 AS sort_order
FROM metrics
WHERE model_version = 'v1'
  AND run_label = 'first_run'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'v2 - After Fixes' AS model,
    mae_model AS mae_eur,
    3 AS sort_order
FROM metrics
WHERE model_version = 'v2'
  AND run_label = 'after_fix'

ORDER BY sort_order;

datasets.name: 93d6de48
queryLines:
SELECT
    room_type,
    CASE
        WHEN model_version = 'v1'
            THEN 'v1 - First Run'
        WHEN model_version = 'v2'
            THEN 'v2 - After Fixes'
    END AS model,
    COUNT(*) AS n_test,
    ROUND(
        AVG(ABS(model_pred - price)),
        2
    ) AS mae_eur
FROM workspace.gold.price_predictions_naples
WHERE city = 'naples'
  AND split = 'test'
  AND (
      (model_version = 'v1' AND run_label = 'first_run')
      OR
      (model_version = 'v2' AND run_label = 'after_fix')
  )
  AND room_type IS NOT NULL
  AND price IS NOT NULL
  AND model_pred IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY room_type, model_version
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY room_type, model_version;
